steps.what: Observe passenger movement and judge whether advice is needed
Advise passengers to be seated and orderly
Check the response and decide whether further intervention is required

tasks.design: Keep observation, situational advice and checking the response with the driver. A {DOCS} script or a prerecorded announcement cannot establish that passengers have complied, and no new announcement system is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The need for advice depends on what passengers are doing now.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change removes this situational interaction.
tasks.still_hard: A passenger may be unable rather than unwilling to sit down.
tasks.human_edge: The driver can distinguish a safety problem from an accessibility need and adapt the instruction.
tasks.altitude: No change in time or safety responsibility is established.

evidence.claim: Situational passenger advice and observing the response remain human work; routine instructions do not require a new record in this baseline.

assumptions: Boundary includes observing, speaking and checking the response. A serious incident report is a separate event, not a routine record created for every instruction.
No structured disorder flag or passenger-compliance field feeds a machine. The driver produces the choice in s1 and checks actual behaviour in s3; all35 observation and judgement hours are retained.
Neither a native view, template nor till setting removes the situational speech in this task. Any actual incident-record workflow would need its own measured write and send steps.
No system is installed, so ongoing upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether a current recorded-announcement procedure replaces any routine speech
research_questions: Is any repeatable scripted announcement genuinely separate from situational advice?

already_counted.description: Observation, passenger advice and response checking

incremental.description: No new system or recording workflow

approvals.approved_version: The exact passenger instruction delivered in the current circumstances, checked as spoken

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R100 and0 upkeep, net0. Both bounds retain observation20, speech65 and response checking15. A standard script does not remove any of those actions without an actual announcement substitution.

steps.what: Collect fare evidence and count actual cash receipts
Record cash receipts and ticket fares in the log book
Reconcile the log against actual receipts and explain differences

tasks.design: Use a native shift-log form in the {OTHER} ticketing and fare system to reuse existing ticket references and shift fields instead of recopying them into a paper book. The driver still counts cash, enters actual receipt totals and explanations, and reconciles the final log.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing ticket and shift details are copied again by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A native log view and form may reuse those records while keeping actual cash entry explicit.
tasks.still_hard: Recorded ticket sales do not establish how much cash is physically present.
tasks.human_edge: The driver can investigate a real cash difference rather than force totals to match.
tasks.altitude: Less copying leaves more attention for actual discrepancies.

evidence.claim: Native ticket-system shift logs can reuse recorded ticket references and shift details; the specific configuration and labour estimate are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes fare evidence collection, actual cash counting, the real log write and reconciliation. Payment collection itself is separate; no existing ticket-system runtime earns a labour saving.

OTHER means the ticketing and fare system. Ticket transactions are produced during existing fare collection, and the driver checks shift identifier, route, ticket references, fare totals and counted cash in s1 and captures the actual cash and differences in s2-s3. All30 capture/counting hours and20 retained log-entry hours are counted. Missing ticket records use the current manual log.
Test the native shift-log form before custom integration. Reusing stable references removes transcription; actual cash and discrepancy explanations are never inferred.
No automated posting, send or machine commit is proposed. The driver's ordinary same-system save has no self-approval gate and earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether a manual duplicate fare log remains today
Native shift-log support and offline behaviour
research_questions: How much real copying remains after actual cash capture and reconciliation are retained?

already_counted.description: Actual cash counting, changed-field entry, reconciliation and explanations

incremental.description: Resolve unmatched references and log-form failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R70 gross30 minus2 upkeep gives28 net. Low: paper tickets and poor shift identifiers leave40 of50 log-writing hours, totalR90 plus2 upkeep, net8. High: compatible ticket references and shift fields remove22 copying hours, leaving28 log hours and totalR78 plus2 upkeep, net20; cash counting and reconciliation remain50 hours.

tasks.short: Read maps and plan a bus route

steps.what: Identify stops, timetable constraints and vehicle restrictions
Read maps to plan bus routes and review road restrictions
Trace a candidate route between the required stops
Check bus suitability and choose a safe route within the assignment

tasks.design: Configure a bus-suitable route view in the {OTHER} route-planning system and let its native routing function draft a candidate between checked stops. The driver supplies restrictions, reviews map layers and checks the candidate; the design neither changes an authorized service route automatically nor controls the vehicle.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually locating stops and tracing roads takes time even when the requirements are known.
tasks.enabler_now: Native route planning can draft a candidate, subject to the actual restriction layers being suitable for buses.
tasks.still_hard: A mapped route may omit a temporary closure, difficult turn or unsuitable stop approach.
tasks.human_edge: The driver combines vehicle knowledge and local road experience with the map.
tasks.altitude: Less map tracing leaves more time to check real route suitability.

reach.task: Check a route against vehicle restrictions

evidence.claim: Native route planners can draft candidate routes from stops and vehicle constraints, but bus-layer suitability and time savings require local validation.

assumptions: Boundary is map-based route preparation, not driving, dispatch approval or network timetable design. No routine route report is assumed beyond the route choice itself.

The dispatcher produces the assignment and stop sequence; the driver checks stop coordinates, timetable windows, vehicle height, width, length, weight and known exclusions in s1. Its20 hours retain all constraint capture; s2 retains21 hours for map-layer review. Missing coordinates or restrictions require manual map tracing, not unqualified native routing.

OTHER means the route-planning system. Test native bus profiles and restriction layers before code. s3 only drafts a candidate and s4 retains the full25-hour human suitability check; no final external send or route commit is proposed.
Saving a private route choice, if supported, is ordinary author work without a gate or save-time saving. The2-hour allowance covers map-profile corrections and routing failures.
unknowns: Actual frequency of new route planning versus familiar fixed routes
research_questions: Do native candidates remain usable after bus restrictions, stop approaches and closures are checked?

already_counted.description: Constraint capture, map-layer review and final bus-suitability checking

incremental.description: Correct route profiles and handle failed candidate generation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R66 gross34 minus2 upkeep gives32 net. Low: weak bus restriction layers require15 of25 tracing hours to remain and all map reading stays, R90 plus2 upkeep, net8. High: compatible layers remove20 tracing hours and five stop-location hours, R75 plus2 upkeep, net23; all constraint capture and final suitability checks remain.

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate fare-log copying and map tracing while preserving cash accuracy, passenger safety and route judgement.
role.ambitious_version: A bus driver who spends less time duplicating records and more attention on passengers and safe service.
